email_draft.subject: Trek Africa Guide - South Luangwa walking safari shipped and live (run 2026-11-09)
email_draft.body:
Hi Foscod,

Shipped this run: the first South Luangwa walking safari activity guide (activities category). The live South Luangwa attraction page leads with 'Guided walking safaris' but had no activity guide or related-activities card behind it - its booking button was only a game drive - so readers arriving for a walk had nothing to plan from.

Live receipt: https://trekafricaguide.com/activities/south-luangwa-walking-safari/ - HTTP 200, verified today: full h2 flow matching our golden-monook reference page (About this activity, Highlights, Best time to participate, Planning notes, Booking option, Nearby stays), clean rendered copy, no exposed markup, and the guide now listed in the activities archive, homepage search and the South Luangwa attraction page's Related activities carousel.

All facts sourced from the official Zambia Tourism South Luangwa guide plus our own attraction guide: the 'walking safari originated here' claim, half-day nature walks vs multi-day mobile walks, the qualified walking guide + armed ranger escort, dry-season timing, Mfuwe/Proflight and Chipata access. Zambia's DNPW site was unreachable from here, so park entry fees are NOT reprinted - the page tells readers to confirm entry terms with their operator.

Photos: honest zero-photo state again; six licensed walking-safari subjects logged for the photo backlog. Booking: no CTA - no verified exact OTA walking-safari listing exists (search checked today), and the attraction keeps its existing game-drive booking button unchanged.

Housekeeping: git push and Netlify deploys both worked (commit a09e697, receipt 06bdec9). One hygiene change: I removed .env.netlify from the repo because it contained a deploy-hook URL; the file stays on local machines only. Still pending on your side: CMS check of the new activity document (publishable-key read stays blocked), and the owner Gmail sign-in - two run reports (Kigali Serena and this one) are drafted and waiting to send.
